title: Orsen and the Tryouts
premise: Zephyrine Vane has spent high school as a ghost, venting through an anonymous account called @vane_truths that has quietly exposed a cheating ring at her elite academy. When the college essay prompt asks her to describe a moment of injustice she witnessed, she can't write anything safe, because her honest answer would out her own account and destroy the fragile truce keeping her scholarship intact. To earn the recommendation letter she needs, she must join the school's mock trial team, whose regional championship the headmaster is using to launder his reputation. As the final round collides with the disciplinary hearing over @vane_truths, Zephyrine realizes the trial is about her, and she chooses to defend herself in open court of her peers, winning acquittal in the only court that matters and claiming her name at last.
about_author: Zephyrine Montrose is a former debate coach from coastal Maine who writes about teenagers forced to grow up in institutions that prefer them silent. Her short fiction has appeared in three small literary journals under other names, which she considers research.

chapters.title: The Prompt Nobody Can Refuse
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. Senior year is a countdown; her anonymous account @vane_truths is her only voice. The common app essay prompt lands, and drafting it means writing the truth she's hidden. When her best friend Theo is suspended on fabricated charges tied to her leaks, the emotional beat is guilt cracking her invisibility open.

chapters.title: Tryouts for a Championship That Doesn't Matter
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV. She auditions for mock trial to access the headmaster's office and the records that could clear Theo, telling herself it's a heist, not a betrayal of her loner code. Teammate Dev sees through her instantly but keeps her secret. The emotional beat is the terrifying discovery that she's good at being seen.

chapters.title: Objection, Your Honor
chapters.summary: Alternating Zephyrine and Dev POV. Regionals begin as Zephyrine finds the records proving the headmaster manufactured Theo's charges, but he discovers her identity and offers a deal: throw the final, keep the scholarship. Rising tension peaks as she realizes the championship is theater, and the emotional beat is rage hardening into resolve.

chapters.title: The One That Does
chapters.summary: Zephyrine's POV, climax and resolution. At the disciplinary hearing scheduled against the final round, she cross-examines the headmaster using his own trial tactics, exposing him before the assembled school and posting the evidence as her final @vane_truths. She loses the trophy, keeps the truth, signs her essay with her real name, and the beat is arrival, not victory.
